table.name: TLGNC_SHIPTO_SAREA_RESTR_BTRUL
table.description: Stores the billto-rhythm (rules) for a shipto-sarea. Rules are defined per month, day of the week or day of the month, and can cover an arbitrary number of bill-tos.

column.name: SHIPTO_SAREA_RESTR_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr. The bulk product restriction (of a shipto-sarea) for which the rule is defined.

column.name: BILLTO_SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. The Billto business partner for this rule.

column.name: BILLTO_RULETYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_billto_ruletype_bs. 0=month, 1=day of week, 2=day of month. All rules of the type tlgnc_shipto_sarea_restr.billto_ruletype_cd are active.

column.name: VALUE
column.description: Value of the rule, depends on the rule type: month: 1-12 (jan-dec), day of week: 1-7 (mon-sun), day of month: 1-31.
